tool.name: ampvis2 frequency plot
tool.description: generates a barplot with frequency vs read abundance
tool.command:
Rscript -e ' library(ampvis2) load("$input_dataset")
#if $metadata_list.metadata_select == "select": meta <- data.frame( #for $meta in $metadata_list.metadata_columns: $meta.name, #end for ) colnames(meta) <- c( #for $meta in $metadata_list.metadata_columns: $meta.name, #end for )
#for $meta in $metadata_list.metadata_columns: meta$'$meta.name' <- '$meta.value' #end for #end if
out <- amp_frequency( data, freq = $freq, min_abund = $min_abund, max_abund = $max_abund, log_scale = $log_scale, metadata = meta, metadata_select = "$metadata_list.metadata_select", metadata_column = "$metadata_list.metadata_column" )
write.table(out, file = "output.txt", quote = FALSE, sep = "\t", row.names = TRUE) ' && Rscript -e ' library(ggplot2) library(ampvis2) data <- read.table("output.txt", header = TRUE, sep = "\t") ggplot(data, aes(x = Frequency, y = Abundance)) + geom_bar(stat = "identity") + theme_minimal() + labs(title = "Frequency vs Read Abundance", x = "Frequency", y = "Read Abundance") + theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1)) ' > output.png && Rscript -e ' library(htmltools) library(ampvis2) library(ggplot2) data <- read.table("output.txt", header = TRUE, sep = "\t") p <- ggplot(data, aes(x = Frequency, y = Abundance)) + geom_bar(stat = "identity") + theme_minimal() + labs(title = "Frequency vs Read Abundance", x = "Frequency", y = "Read Abundance") + theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1))
saveHTML(p, file = "output.html") '
tool.help:
What it does ============
Generates a barplot with frequency vs read abundance.
The Galaxy tool calls the `amp_frequency <https://kasperskytte.github.io/ampvis2/reference/amp_frequency.html>`_ function of the ampvis2 package.
Input =====
An ampvis2 RDS dataset obtained by the ``ampvis2: load`` tool (or ``ampvis2: mergereplicates`` or one of the ``ampvis2: subset ...`` tools).
The metadata list output of the ``ampvis2: load`` tool (or ``ampvis2: mergereplicates`` or the ``ampvis2: subset sample`` tool). This input is only used for providing values to the parameters alowing to select metadata variables or values.
Output ======
A frequency plot in the chosen output format.
